title: nexus.agent-observation.v1
description: One line of <agentic_root>/claude/observer/events.jsonl, written by the nexus-agent-observer Claude Code hook adapter. One record per hook event. Values that are not available are null. Never contains tool inputs/outputs, prompt text beyond the 120-char task summary, env values or secrets.

event.description: Claude Code hook event name as received (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Stop, StopFailure, SessionEnd, ...).

agentId.description: Main agent: the session id. Subagent: the Claude Code agent_id. Background shell: the tool_use_id of the Bash call that started it.

parentAgentId.description: null for the main agent; the spawning agent's agentId for subagents and background shells.

state.description: working: UserPromptSubmit / PreToolUse / PostToolUse(Failure) of the agent itself, and SubagentStart; waiting: Notification; done: Stop, SubagentStop, SessionEnd, or a completed <task-notification>; failed: StopFailure, a failed/killed <task-notification>, or PostToolUseFailure of a background Bash launch; unknown otherwise (e.g. SessionStart).

task.description: Subagent description / background shell description, or a prompt summary for the main agent; single line, truncated to 120 chars.

tool.description: Tool name only (never its input or output).

toolUseId.description: tool_use_id of the tool event; lets consumers link a Task/Agent tool call to the subagent it spawned.

repository.description: Basename of the git top-level directory.

worktree.description: Worktree path when cwd is inside a linked git worktree that differs from the main repository root; otherwise null.

startedAt.description: When this agent was first observed.

inputTokens.description: Cumulative input tokens for this agent (input + cache creation + cache read), read incrementally from the documented transcript_path / agent_transcript_path on Stop/SubagentStop; later records repeat the last measured value. null until first measured.

outputTokens.description: Cumulative output tokens for this agent; same source and cadence as inputTokens.
